title: Supervisor, Environmental Health and Safety
description:

About the Company

Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Role Summary

The Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the implementation, compliance, and continuous improvement of environmental, health, and safety programs within the organization. This role requires a proactive approach to identify potential hazards, ensure regulatory compliance, and promote a culture of safety among employees.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Program Development and Management:

• Develop, implement, and maintain EHS policies, procedures, and programs in accordance with local, state, and federal regulations.

• Ensure effective communication of EHS policies to all employees.

• Regulatory Compliance:

• Monitor and ensure compliance with environmental and safety regulations, standards, and best practices.

• Conduct regular audits and inspections to identify compliance gaps and ensure corrective actions are taken.

• Training and Awareness:

• Design and deliver EHS training programs for employees at all levels, ensuring understanding and compliance with safety protocols.

• Promote a culture of safety through awareness campaigns and engagement initiatives.

• Incident Management:

• Investigate workplace accidents, incidents, and near misses; prepare reports and recommend corrective actions.

• Maintain records of incidents and ensure proper documentation and reporting to regulatory bodies.

• Risk Assessment:

• Conduct risk assessments and safety inspections to identify potential hazards and recommend mitigation strategies.

• Work with management to prioritize safety improvements and allocate resources effectively.

• Emergency Preparedness:

• Develop and implement emergency response plans and drills to prepare employees for potential emergency situations.

• Coordinate with local emergency services and ensure compliance with emergency response regulations.

• Data Analysis and Reporting:

• Analyze safety data and trends to provide insights and recommendations for continuous improvement.

• Prepare and present EHS reports to management, highlighting key metrics and areas for improvement.

• Collaboration and Communication:

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to promote a safe and healthy work environment.

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

We’re looking for a Product Security Engineer to join our team and help strengthen how security is built into Supabase’s products, platform, and engineering workflows as we continue to scale. You’ll work closely with software engineers, infrastructure teams, and technical leadership, helping us proactively reduce risk earlier in the development lifecycle and ship securely by default.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

- Identify and close gaps across application security, secure design review, and vulnerability management.

- Partner closely with engineering teams to provide product-focused security expertise and shape a modern security program.

- Mature how we think about security in a developer-first environment, balancing pragmatism with strong technical judgment.

- Distinguish between theoretical risk and material business risk to prioritize security efforts effectively.

- Improve security posture through scalable mechanisms like tooling, automation, secure defaults, and developer-friendly guardrails.

- Support security incident response by helping triage, investigate, and coordinate remediation for product and platform security issues.

- Possess a deep understanding of application security fundamentals, including auth, session management, APIs, and secrets handling.

- Have experience with vulnerability triage, bug bounty programs, responsible disclosure, or security incident response.

- Have experience with or interest in Postgres, Kubernetes, or building security guardrails that enable rather than enforce.

About PSD

Performance Systems Development is a national leader in building science and energy efficiency. Since our founding 25 years ago, we've grown to over 100 employees who are passionate about delivering creative and effective solutions that drive change in how buildings use energy.

We focus on three core areas:

1. High-impact energy efficiency programs that improve building performance.

2. Workforce development and industry training to upskill professionals.

3. Innovative software solutions to manage and analyze energy efficiency data.

Our work advances energy policies, supports contractors, and drives sustainability efforts across the industry.

Description

The Engineering Manager leads PSD's software engineering team of .NET and React developers, QA, and specialized roles, including building energy simulation, and is responsible for the team's people, delivery, quality, and day-to-day operations.

PSD's software supports utility energy efficiency programs, and the team delivers both product development and contracted client work. This role oversees the process that turns that demand into predictable sprint commitments, working with the Product Manager and Delivery Managers on priorities and with the Software Architect on technical direction. Because clients rely on PSD's energy models and program data, this person treats calculation and data accuracy as a core part of quality.

The role is mostly people and delivery leadership, with limited hands-on work, and requires strong communication across business units and a commitment to software craftsmanship.

What You Bring

• Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• 8+ years in software development, including designing and building enterprise software.

• 2+ years of experience managing software engineers.

• Strong technical skills: able to review code, assess design and architecture decisions, and engage credibly with engineers on implementation details.

• Strong working knowledge of agile software development and hands-on experience running Scrum (certification such as CSM or PSM is a plus).

• Hands-on experience applying AI tools across the SDLC, including spec-driven development, AI-assisted coding, testing and QA, and backlog refinement.

• Solid understanding of CI/CD (build and deployment pipelines, environment promotion, release management) and automated testing strategy (unit test coverage, integration testing, and end-to-end frameworks such as Cypress).

• Experience with defect tracking and production support: triage, prioritization, severity classification, and seeing issues through to resolution.

• Experience leading a remote or distributed team.

Desired Traits

• Strong .NET/C# enterprise development background. React, Python, or Ruby experience is a plus.

• Experience with calculation-heavy or data-critical software, such as engineering or energy software.

• Experience retiring or migrating legacy systems.

• Experience balancing product development with client-funded work, and understanding business processes and client needs.

• Experience leading a team's adoption of AI tools and measuring its impact on delivery and quality.

• Experience supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001 or a similar compliance audit.
